sessions.prompt:
Add code(number) to rooms.py: the code of room number, "R" followed by the number ("R7"). Add a Hotel class to rooms.py with add_room(number) and rooms(), the sorted list of room codes. Add tests.

The plan for code has one more step: the number in a room code is zero-padded to 3 digits ("R007", "R012"). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: a night in a room costs 9000 cents.

Add a Bookings class to bookings.py. Bookings(hotel) works on a Hotel. book(room, guest, checkin, checkout) books room (a room code) for guest and returns a booking id: an int counter that starts at 1. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): checkout must be after checkin; otherwise book raises ValueError and books nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a guest name that is empty or only spaces raises ValueError and books nothing; names are stored without surrounding spaces.

Add Bookings.get(bid), which returns the booking as a tuple (room, guest, checkin, checkout); an unknown id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a booking is at most 14 nights; a longer one raises ValueError and books nothing.

Add Bookings.is_free(room, day): False when a booking of room covers the night of day, else True. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a room is never booked twice for the same night: a booking that overlaps another booking of the same room raises ValueError and books nothing.

Design decision for this project: the checkout day is not a booked night, so a room can be booked from the day another booking of it checks out.

Add price(bookings, bid) to billing.py: the price of the booking's nights, in cents. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: cancelling a booking costs a fee of 10% of its price, rounded to the nearest cent.

Add Bookings.of_guest(guest): the ids of the bookings of guest, in id order. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: Friday and Saturday nights cost 20% more than other nights, rounded to the nearest cent.

Add Bookings.cancel(bid), which removes the booking and returns the cancellation fee in cents. Add bill(bookings, bid) to billing.py: what the guest pays for the booking. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a tourist tax of 200 cents per night is added to every bill; the weekend price rule does not apply to it.

Add Bookings.guests(): the sorted list of distinct guest names over all bookings. Add tests.

The plan for Bookings.book has one more step: each guest name is stored in title case, so "ann LEE" becomes "Ann Lee". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add export_bookings(bookings, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per booking in id order (id, room, guest, checkin, checkout), with ISO dates. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: an exported bookings file starts with the header line id,room,guest,in,out and uses "," as the delimiter.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a night in a room costs 9500 cents, not 9000.
Add Bookings.occupancy(day): the number of rooms booked for the night of day. Add tests.

Add invoice(bookings, bid) to billing.py: a list of text lines for the booking; for now it has one line, "total: <cents>", where <cents> is the bill. Add tests.

The plan for invoice has one more step: before the total line it has one line per night, in date order, "YYYY-MM-DD: <cents>", where <cents> is the room price of that night. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a booking is at most 21 nights, not 14.

Add Bookings.extend(bid, checkout), which moves the checkout of a booking to a later day; the booking rules still apply, and a broken rule raises ValueError and changes nothing. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the cancellation fee is 25% of the price, not 10%.
Add Hotel.remove_room(code), which removes a room from the hotel. Add tests.

Add Bookings.nights_booked(room): the total number of nights booked for room. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): only Saturday nights cost 20% more; Friday nights cost the same as other nights.
Add revenue(bookings) to billing.py: the sum of the bills of all bookings. Add tests.
Add Bookings.find(text): the ids of the bookings whose guest name contains text, ignoring case, in id order. Add tests.

Add Bookings.ids(): all booking ids in order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a night in a room costs 9900 cents, not 9500.

Add Bookings.move(bid, room), which moves a booking to another room; the booking rules still apply, and a broken rule raises ValueError and changes nothing. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the cancellation fee is 20% of the price, not 25%.

Add Bookings.guest_nights(guest): the total number of nights booked by guest. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a booking is at most 28 nights, not 21.

Add busiest_day(bookings) to billing.py: the day with the most rooms booked for its night, the earliest one on a tie, or None when there are no bookings. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
